testResults.name: focused-data-route-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/http/
testResults.result: 46 tests (25 new): workspace list/create/snapshot, backtests history + declared-split detail + launch delegation to the harness adapter, deployments with orders and fail-closed portfolio/risk surfaces (503 {error:{code,message}}, never fabricated), dashboards widget CRUD with JSON persistence round-trip, screeners delegating to the T219 engine with SavedStudy persistence, workspace-state (CLEO projection, lineage, evidence, consent audit), all under the bearer-auth boundary with services resolved from app.state mirroring the chat router pattern

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/thesis/http tests/thesis/http && uv run --extra dev ty check src/thesis/http
testResults.result: ruff, format, and ty clean; chat/streaming/application tests stayed green

limitations: Backtest/deployment stores are local JSON/in-memory per the local-mode scope; promotion to the Azure workspace persistence is the Azure-mode adapter's later work
The screener market port is injected; wiring it to live lake/universe data is a follow-on integration step
